description: This file is a shell script that contains automated tests for Git's worktree operations, particularly with skip-worktree settings. It includes setup functions, test cases for various scenarios such as reading trees, cleaning, and sparse checkout handling, and uses Git commands to verify behavior.

methods.name: setup_absent
methods.description: Prepares the repository state with a file marked as absent and skip-worktree set.

methods.name: setup_dirty
methods.description: Prepares the repository with a dirty file marked as skip-worktree.

methods.name: test_dirty
methods.description: Verifies the state of a dirty file with skip-worktree set.
